    SELECT

    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

)

    ROUND((gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))::numeric, 2) AS increase
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY increase DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT dc.name AS distribution_center, ROUND((SUM(oi.sale_price - ii.cost))::numeric, 2) AS gross_margin
FROM public.order_items oi
JOIN public.inventory_items ii ON ii.id = oi.inventory_item_id
JOIN public.distribution_centers dc ON dc.id = ii.product_distribution_center_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
  AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'Purchase' THEN session_id END)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0))::numeric, 4) AS conversion_rate FROM public.events WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH jan_users AS (
    SELECT id, created_at AS user_created_at
    FROM public.users
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
user_non_cancelled_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        u.id AS user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM jan_users u
    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND oi.created_at >= u.user_created_at
      AND oi.created_at < u.user_created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
    GROUP BY u.id, oi.order_id
),
users_with_two_plus AS (
    SELECT user_id
    FROM user_non_cancelled_orders
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) >= 2
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (COUNT(DISTINCT uwtp.user_id)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ju.id), 0))::numeric,
        6
    ) AS share
FROM jan_users ju
LEFT JOIN users_with_two_plus uwtp ON uwtp.user_id = ju.id

SELECT u.traffic_source,
       ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 0))::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue_per_user
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY u.traffic_source
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at)) / 3600))::numeric, 2) AS median_hours
FROM public.order_items
WHERE status = 'Complete'
AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_users,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2) AS total_net_revenue
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
  AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
  AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
  AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH fb_users AS (
  SELECT id FROM public.users 
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook' 
  AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN fb_users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, order_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
)
SELECT 
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (r2.order_time::date - r1.order_time::date)) AS median_days
FROM ranked_orders r1
JOIN ranked_orders r2 ON r1.user_id = r2.user_id AND r1.rn = 1 AND r2.rn = 2

WITH user_cohort AS (
    SELECT
        id AS user_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS acq_month,
        created_at AS user_created_at
    FROM public.users
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT
        u.user_id,
        u.acq_month,
        u.user_created_at,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled') AS non_cancelled_items
    FROM user_cohort u
    LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.user_id
    GROUP BY u.user_id, u.acq_month, u.user_created_at, oi.order_id
),
user_has_order AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        acq_month,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN order_time IS NOT NULL
             AND order_time >= user_created_at
             AND order_time < user_created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
             AND non_cancelled_items > 0
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS placed_within_30
    FROM user_orders
    GROUP BY user_id, acq_month
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(acq_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS acquisition_month,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(placed_within_30)::double precision / COUNT(*))::numeric,
        4
    ) AS share
FROM user_has_order
GROUP BY acq_month
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH facebook_users AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.users
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN facebook_users fu ON fu.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS order_rank
    FROM user_orders
),
second_third AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order_time,
        MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 3 THEN order_time END) AS third_order_time
    FROM ranked_orders
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
),
diffs AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (third_order_time - second_order_time)) / 86400 AS days_diff
    FROM second_third
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff))::numeric, 2) AS median_days
FROM diffs

WITH user_spend AS (
    SELECT user_id, SUM(sale_price) AS gross_spend
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gross_spend)::numeric, 2) AS p90_gross_spend
FROM user_spend

WITH user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        u.id AS user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.users u
    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Organic'
      AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
      AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY u.id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM user_orders
),
first_second AS (
    SELECT 
        f.user_id,
        f.order_time AS first_order_time,
        s.order_time AS second_order_time,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM (s.order_time - f.order_time)) AS days_diff
    FROM (SELECT * FROM ranked_orders WHERE rn = 1) f
    JOIN (SELECT * FROM ranked_orders WHERE rn = 2) s ON f.user_id = s.user_id
)
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff) AS median_days
FROM first_second

WITH order_values AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    user_id,
    MIN(created_at) AS order_time,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS order_value,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Cancelled') AS non_cancelled_items
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY order_id, user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Cancelled') > 0
),
user_order_ranks AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    user_id,
    order_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS order_rank
  FROM order_values
),
medians AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN order_rank = 1 THEN 'first' ELSE 'repeat' END AS order_type,
    order_value
  FROM user_order_ranks
)
SELECT
  order_type,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) AS median_order_value
FROM medians
GROUP BY order_type

SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between))::numeric, 2) AS p95_days
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, 
         (second_order::date - first_order::date) AS days_between
  FROM (
    SELECT user_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN order_seq = 1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order,
           MAX(CASE WHEN order_seq = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order
    FROM (
      SELECT user_id, order_time,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS order_seq
      FROM (
        SELECT order_id, user_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_time
        FROM public.order_items
        WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
        AND status <> 'Cancelled'
        GROUP BY order_id, user_id
      ) t
    ) t2
    WHERE order_seq IN (1, 2)
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
  ) t3
) t4

WITH search_users AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Search'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id,
    oi.order_id,
    MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN search_users su ON su.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_id,
    order_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
),
first_second AS (
  SELECT 
    r1.user_id,
    r1.order_time::date AS first_order_date,
    r2.order_time::date AS second_order_date,
    (r2.order_time::date - r1.order_time::date) AS days_between
  FROM ranked_orders r1
  JOIN ranked_orders r2 ON r1.user_id = r2.user_id AND r1.rn = 1 AND r2.rn = 2
)
SELECT 
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) AS median_days
FROM first_second
